Breakout swarm-211304-tb6n-d1 concluded on prop_cd3dc858 v2 (2/2 agree; whole text: room_status room="swarm-211304-tb6n-d1").
DECISION 1: YES, the default of CHATROOM_MAX_ROOMS_PER_RUN stays at 12. Evidence: src/hub.ts:62 sets it env-overridable (`?? 12`), equal to MAX_LIVE_PER_ROOM at src/hub.ts:63; src/hub.ts:98-101 counts only OPEN rooms sharing one swarm-<id> prefix, so concluded rooms free slots and unrelated runs are unaffected; the swarm skill sets the value explicitly at hub launch for swarm runs (skills/swarm/SKILL.md:40 =100 for the 40-agent lobby, :86 lists 40 among "Normal values" for launched hubs), so 12 is only the unconfigured code default for hubs started without that env. Its "Normal values" being 40 does not argue for changing the code default: SKILL.md:86 also says "Ask before changing anything on the hub that outlives the room being launched" (its cautionary example concerns CHATROOM_MAX_LIVE_AGENTS, not this cap), and a conservative default plus an explicit per-launch override is the intended design. No test or incident in the repo shows 12 blocking a normal run (grep for ROOMS_PER_RUN hits only src/hub.ts and src/index.ts:249).

DECISION 2: YES, the "Do not glob" comment at scripts/offline-runner.mjs:1 is justified. scripts/ contains scripts that launch live model seats — scripts/sandbox-claude-live.ts:62 spawn("claude", ...), scripts/bench-steer-claude.ts:65 spawn("claude", ...), scripts/adjudicator-trial.ts:41 spawn("claude", ["-p", ...]) — and scripts that bind network ports, e.g. scripts/openrouter-smoke.ts:103 stub.listen(STUB_PORT) on a fixed port. None of these is in the explicit offlineScripts list (scripts/offline-runner.mjs:26-182; only adjudicator-trial.test.ts at :36), so a broad glob over scripts/ would pull live, costly or port-conflicting runs into the offline suite. Even a narrow *.test.ts glob is unsafe: unlisted scripts/bench-harness.test.ts:39 and scripts/bench-seat.test.ts:31 bind 127.0.0.1 port pairs.
